title: The long walk
starting_code: # Walk to the little fence pen in one instruction.
hints: You need to move right across the grass and the path.
Count the steps to the mark by the fence pen.
Use an argument inside the brackets of the `move_right` method to reach it in one instruction.
intro: Let us walk across the meadow to that little fence pen on the right. We can reach it in just one instruction if we use an argument!
outro: That was so fast! Arguments save us from typing the same instruction over and over.
learned: Now you know what an argument is, and that the move methods have one that says how many steps to take.
